verdict.rationale: The serverless docs say 100+ models are billed per token, with cached input tokens billed at a separate cached rate. A community user quoted a concrete per-1K-token price and described self-serve signup by email with $25 of credit, which suggests prices are visible without contacting sales. The pack never cites a public pricing page or a full per-model price table, so 'every hosted model' remains unproven. Missing for 10: a cited public pricing page listing per-token rates for every hosted model, first-party confirmation that no sales contact is needed, current independent corroboration of the published rates.
